title: ATLAS: Adversarial, Traceable, Latent-Criterion, Auditable, and Seed-Calibrated Task Acceptance (MRF-2026-01 reproducibility data)
description: Reproducibility data for Montana Research Foundation preprint MRF-2026-01, "ATLAS: Adversarial, Traceable, Latent-Criterion, Auditable, and Seed-Calibrated Task Acceptance": per-rollout aggregate records and a self-contained verify.py that recomputes the paper's headline from the records alone. Task families, raw agent transcripts, and held-out grading data are withheld under contamination control.
